decision_conditions:
The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the original planning
permission 22/2360/FUL on the 08.08.2023
REASON: To conform with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
description: Variation of condition C9 (approved drawings) and variation of conditions C6 (Refuse storage arrangements) and C11 (delivery, servicing and operational waste) of planning approval  22/2360/FUL, as subsequently varied under ref: 24/1707/VRC and PA25/0122 to allow for the following amendments: Rear building commercial plant room no longer required, therefore area incorporated into residential unit 8. Rear building communal entrance relocated off the brook path, serving residential unit 9 and Class E space. Rear building window fenestration on North-west and south west roof elevations amended; Front building window fenestration on South-west elevation amended to align with internal layout. Front building rear elevation, previous existing brick boundary wall replaced with new build wall. Bin store locations for residential and commercial units amended. (Updated Drawing and Design Statement received 10.11.2025 reinstating brickwall on Boundary with Treen Avenue).
